title: 360. Paint House

examples.explanation: Paint house 0 blue (2), house 1 green (5) and house 2 blue (3) for 2 + 5 + 3 = 10.
With one house, pick the cheapest color, which costs 2.
Paint house 0 red (1) and house 1 green (4) for 1 + 4 = 5.

hints: Track the cheapest total ending with each color after every house.
Each new total adds the current painting cost to the better of the two totals that used a different color before.
